preconditions.description: The grid has between 1 and 100 rows.
Each row in the grid has between 1 and 100 columns.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= grid[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains either 0 (water) or 1 (land).

postconditions.expression: result == -1 if not any(1 in row for row in grid) else max(max(abs(i - x) + abs(j - y) for x, row in enumerate(grid) for y, val in enumerate(row) if val == 1) for i, j in product(range(len(grid)), range(len(grid[0]))))
postconditions.description: The maximum distance to the nearest land cell for any water cell is returned. If there are no land or water cells, return -1.
